annotations.title: Create a paused ad campaign (Meta, TikTok, X, Google, LinkedIn, Reddit or Pinterest)

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Creates a Meta Instant Form lead campaign (goal lead_generation, the ad set's leadGenFormId from ads_lead_forms_list, placements without Audience Network, the age range and countries in targeting) with one image ad, or video ads, created PAUSED. It lands in the owner's Proposed campaigns and never runs or spends until the owner approves it (ads_campaign_approve). headline, body, one creative and budget (dollars; budgetType daily or lifetime) are required. The creative is one of: imageUrl (https on an allowed host: *.convex.cloud, img.clerk.com, ui-avatars.com, images.unsplash.com, *.googleusercontent.com, cdn.shopify.com, commerce.mdostal.com, shop.mdostal.com; anything else, upload it with POST /api/v2/media/upload-url), imageMediaId (that upload's storageId), creativeId, video, or videos (several video ads in one ad set for an A/B test, each { mediaId | contentId | metaVideoId, name?, thumbnailUrl? }). placements: automatic (default), facebook, instagram, facebook_instagram, feeds, reels, stories, or { platforms, surfaces }; never Audience Network. savedTargetingId reuses a saved audience (Ads > Audiences) under your own targeting; interest ids come from ads_targeting_search. promotedObject.pageId picks the Facebook Page. goal messages instead creates a click-to-message ad (Messenger + Instagram Direct, imageUrl only, no form): the brand's automatic first reply greets people with quick replies tagged with armKey, and each conversation lands as a lead with its ad/arm attribution; also PAUSED and proposed. goal traffic or conversions (FFE-1537) creates a website campaign that sends people to targetUrl (required; UTM parameters are added from the owner's ads config): the same creative sources, or creatives (several image ads in one ad set, each { imageUrl | imageMediaId | creativeId, headline?, body?, description?, linkUrl?, name? }), plus description (the line under the headline) and callToAction. conversions optimizes for a pixel event on the brand's selected pixel (promotedObject.customEventType, default COMPLETE_REGISTRATION) and is refused with code PIXEL_NOT_PROVEN unless the readiness check `pixel` passes: read ads_readiness with objective conversions first and tell the user what it says to fix. Per ad set (FFE-1600, Meta website campaigns): optimizationGoal picks what the ad set optimises for: link_clicks or landing_page_views (goal traffic), complete_registration, start_trial or paid_conversion (goal conversions on the brand's pixel, the same PIXEL_NOT_PROVEN check; paid_conversion uses the owner's paid event, Purchase or Subscribe); goal may then be left out, and promotedObject.customEventType is not sent with it. bidStrategy is highest_volume (Meta gets the most results for the budget, the default), cost_per_result (an average cost-per-result goal) or bid_cap (a hard cap per auction); costPerResultGoal is that amount in dollars (for example 20 for $20 per sign-up) and on its own means cost_per_result. Which goals and strategies are on and the cost-per-result range are the owner's ads config: a refusal answers 400 with code OPTIMISATION_GOAL_NOT_ALLOWED, BID_STRATEGY_NOT_ALLOWED or COST_PER_RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE and says what is allowed. platform tiktok with goal traffic or conversions creates a TikTok video campaign on the brand's connected TikTok ad account instead (video or videos as { libraryItemId | storageId }, a daily budget, schedule.endDate, targeting.countries, an https targetUrl, and promotedObject.pixelId for conversions); it answers 403 until the owner's admin has enabled TikTok ad creation. platform twitter (or x, FFE-1606) creates an X website-card campaign on the brand's connected X ad account: goal traffic, engagement or awareness (required), headline (card title, up to 70 characters), body (post text, up to 256), imageUrl (https card image), targetUrl (https), a daily budget at or above the X daily minimum, schedule.endDate, and targeting.countries only; description, callToAction, video and creatives are refused. It answers 403 NETWORK_CREATE_DISABLED until the owner has switched X creation on (Ads > Spend controls > Networks). platform google, linkedin, reddit or pinterest (FFE-1606) creates the same campaign the dashboard builds for that network on its connected ad account, with the same validation (google: the google object (campaignType, headlines, descriptions, images...) plus headline, body, targetUrl and a daily budget; linkedin: headline, body, imageUrl or video, targetUrl, daily budget; reddit: headline, one of imageUrl, video or carouselCards, targetUrl, daily or lifetime budget; pinterest: headline, imageUrl, targetUrl, optional boardId, daily or lifetime budget), each answering 403 NETWORK_CREATE_DISABLED until the owner has switched that network's creation on. To boost an already-published X post instead, use ads_boost_create. ads_readiness lists networkSwitches: per network, whether create and boost are on, the daily minimum, and whether this tool can create there (keyCreate). Every campaign from this tool is PAUSED and proposed; a budget above the owner's caps is refused. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns.)

adAccountId.description: Default: the brand's selected ad account; must match it.

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

aiDisclosure.description: Mark the video ads as AI-generated (set automatically for flayr AI videos). platform tiktok (FFE-1607): accepted and recorded, but the ad network API flayr creates through has no TikTok AI-generated-content field yet, so it is not applied: the response says aiDisclosure.applied false, and the owner must turn on TikTok's AI-generated content setting in TikTok Ads Manager before approving.

armKey.description: messages only: the test arm in each quick-reply payload and lead (default: from the headline).

bidStrategy.description: FFE-1600, Meta traffic / conversions: highest_volume (most results for the budget, Meta's default), cost_per_result (an average cost-per-result goal) or bid_cap (a hard cap per auction). Allowed strategies are the owner's ads config (400 BID_STRATEGY_NOT_ALLOWED).

boardId.description: platform pinterest only, optional: the Pinterest board the ad Pin is created on.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

budget.description: In dollars (account currency). Above the owner's spend caps or the account limit the create is refused (400). platform tiktok, twitter, google, linkedin: dollars per day (the whole run, per day x days, is reserved against the caps). reddit, pinterest: per day, or the whole run with budgetType lifetime.

budgetType.description: Default lifetime on Meta. platform tiktok, twitter, google, linkedin: daily only. reddit, pinterest: daily or lifetime.

callToAction.description: A CTA from the ads create config (default: the owner's default, e.g. LEARN_MORE; SIGN_UP suits a lead form).

carouselCards.description: platform reddit only: carousel cards instead of imageUrl, as the dashboard Reddit create.

costPerResultGoal.description: FFE-1600: dollars per result for cost_per_result or bid_cap (required with them; alone it means cost_per_result). Must be inside the owner's configured range (400 COST_PER_RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE).

creativeId.description: lead_generation, traffic, conversions: a saved ad creative id instead of imageUrl. A website campaign uses its image only; the copy and link are this request's.

creatives.description: traffic / conversions on Meta: several image ads in one ad set, up to the ads create config cap. Instead of the single-creative fields, not with them.

items.description: Exactly one of imageUrl, imageMediaId or creativeId; copy left out is the campaign's own.

description.description: traffic / conversions on Meta: the line under the headline (link description).

destinationId.description: traffic / conversions: on an ad account under the landing destination registry, the registered destination to send people to; the registry then sets targetUrl.

goal.description: Meta: lead_generation (Instant Form), messages (click-to-message, Messenger + Instagram Direct), traffic (link clicks to targetUrl) or conversions (a pixel event on targetUrl). TikTok: traffic or conversions. twitter, google, linkedin, reddit, pinterest (FFE-1606): one of the goals the owner's ads config allows for that network (e.g. traffic, engagement, awareness, video_views).

google.description: platform google only, and required there: { campaignType (demand_gen, search, display, pmax as the config allows), businessName, headlines, longHeadlines, descriptions, images { landscape, square, portrait, logo, ... } (https on an allowed host; every image is size-checked before anything is created), youtubeVideoIds, keywords, negativeKeywords, channels }, as the dashboard Google create.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key return the first result instead of creating twice.

imageMediaId.description: lead_generation, traffic, conversions: a flayr upload (the storageId POST /api/v2/media/upload-url returns) instead of imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: The ad image, https on an allowed host: *.convex.cloud, img.clerk.com, ui-avatars.com, images.unsplash.com, *.googleusercontent.com, cdn.shopify.com, commerce.mdostal.com, shop.mdostal.com. For any other image, upload it and send imageMediaId. Send exactly one of imageUrl, imageMediaId, creativeId, video, videos.

leadGenFormId.description: lead_generation only, and required there: an Instant Form id (GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms).

optimizationGoal.description: FFE-1600, Meta traffic / conversions: what the ad set optimises for. link_clicks and landing_page_views belong to goal traffic; complete_registration, start_trial and paid_conversion (the owner's paid event, Purchase or Subscribe) to goal conversions on the brand's pixel. Not sent with promotedObject.customEventType. The allowed goals are the owner's ads config (400 OPTIMISATION_GOAL_NOT_ALLOWED).

placements.description: Default automatic = Facebook, Instagram and Messenger. Audience Network is never used. feeds/reels/stories (or { surfaces }) pick those positions on Facebook and Instagram.

platform.description: Default facebook. tiktok (traffic / conversions only) creates a TikTok video campaign on the brand's connected TikTok ad account. twitter (or x) creates an X website-card campaign; google, linkedin, reddit and pinterest create a paused standalone campaign with that network's dashboard create body (FFE-1606). Each answers 403 NETWORK_CREATE_DISABLED until the owner switches that network's creation on (GET /api/v2/ads/readiness networkSwitches). openai answers 400 PLATFORM_NOT_SUPPORTED.

promotedObject.description: lead_generation: pageId, the Facebook Page the lead ad runs from. conversions: customEventType, the pixel event to optimize for (Meta defaults to COMPLETE_REGISTRATION; TikTok accepts its optimization event, e.g. ON_WEB_REGISTER), and optionally pixelId, which on Meta must be the brand's selected pixel and on TikTok is required. Not accepted with traffic on Meta.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

savedTargetingId.description: lead_generation, traffic, conversions (Meta): a saved audience id (the id in the Ads > Audiences page URL). Its targeting is the base; fields in `targeting` override it.

schedule.description: ISO dates; default now to +7 days. platform tiktok, twitter, google, linkedin, reddit, pinterest: endDate is required.

smartPlus.description: TikTok only, opt-in after admin enablement; requires conversions with a pixel and event.

targetUrl.description: traffic / conversions only, and required there: the page the ad sends people to (https on TikTok). On Meta the owner's UTM template is appended; TikTok can carry UTM parameters directly in targetUrl.

targeting.description: Age range 13-65 and the usual targeting fields. tiktok: countries (required), age on TikTok's buckets (ageGroups or ageMin/ageMax on bucket edges), gender, interests and behaviors. reddit also takes communities (e.g. r/Portland) and conversationKeywords; pinterest gender and languages; the fields each network reads are the dashboard create's.

ageGroups.description: TikTok only (FFE-1607): TikTok's age buckets, instead of ageMin/ageMax. TikTok has no free age range; ageMin/ageMax must fall on these bucket edges (ageMax 65 or 100 = 55+).

behaviors.description: TikTok only (FFE-1607): behavior ids and hashtag ids (`hashtag:<id>`) from GET /api/v2/ads/targeting/search?platform=tiktok.

interests.description: Meta: interest id strings (GET /api/v2/ads/targeting/search). TikTok (FFE-1607): { id, name } objects from GET /api/v2/ads/targeting/search?platform=tiktok; interest category ids as returned, interestKeyword ids as `keyword:<id>`.

video.description: Meta: exactly one of mediaId, contentId or metaVideoId. TikTok: exactly one of libraryItemId or storageId.

metaVideoId.description: Meta: a video already in the selected ad account.

name.description: The ad name; defaults to the headline, numbered for multiple ads.

videos.description: Several video ads in one ad set, up to the ads create config cap. Each is created PAUSED; a failed attachment is reported in ads and does not undo the campaign.

items.description: Meta: exactly one of mediaId, contentId or metaVideoId. TikTok: exactly one of libraryItemId or storageId.

metaVideoId.description: Meta: a video already in the selected ad account.

name.description: The ad name; defaults to the headline, numbered for multiple ads.

name: ads_campaign_create
title: Create a paused ad campaign (Meta, TikTok, X, Google, LinkedIn, Reddit or Pinterest)
